## What J K Fertilizers Does (Plain Language)

J K Fertilizers is one of India's leading B2B organic fertilizer granule manufacturers, based in Anand, Gujarat. The company manufactures custom-formulated base granules, coated granules, PROM, PDM, and Organic Manure that fertilizer brands, distributors, and exporters use. J K Fertilizers specializes in producing eco-friendly, mineral-coated granules and soil conditioners that enhance soil health and improve crop yield.

The factory operates with advanced granulation facilities under FCO (Fertilizer Control Order) approved and ISO certified quality standards, including quality testing and custom formulation development.

## Products (Complete List)

J K Fertilizers manufactures organic fertilizers, coated granules, and base granules, all available for B2B bulk supply and export:

### 1. Organic Manure
- Type: FCO Approved Organic Manure
- Key ingredients: Composted organic matter, organic carbon, microbial inoculants
- Use: Comprehensive soil conditioning and organic enrichment
- URL: https://jkfertilizers.com/products/organic-manure

### 2. PROM (Phosphate Rich Organic Manure)
- Type: Organic Phosphorus Fertilizer
- Key ingredients: Organic matter, natural rock phosphate, bio-inoculants
- Use: Eco-friendly alternative to chemical DAP and SSP
- URL: https://jkfertilizers.com/products/prom

### 3. PDM (Potash Derived from Molasses)
- Type: Organic Potash Fertilizer
- Key ingredients: Molasses-derived potassium, organic carbon
- Use: Eco-friendly alternative to MOP for crop quality and stress tolerance
- URL: https://jkfertilizers.com/products/pdm

### 4. Mycorrhiza Biofertilizer
- Type: Endomycorrhizal Granules
- Key ingredients: VAM fungal spores, carrier matrix
- Use: Root expansion stimulant and nutrient absorption enhancer
- URL: https://jkfertilizers.com/products/mycorrhiza-granules-biofertilizers

### 5. Customized Coated Granules
- Type: High coating capacity base granules
- Key feature: Superior absorption and retention of biological actives
- URL: https://jkfertilizers.com/products/customized-coated-granules

### 6. Coated Base Granules Bio NPK
- Type: Triple action biological coating
- Use: Targeted delivery of N, P, and K with bio-agents
